question: As per a new study by Greenpeace in 2018, which is the most polluted city on earth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gurugram.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Gurugram** topped the list of the most polluted cities in the world in a recent study conducted by **NGO Greenpeace India.**
 
• It was ranked first among 62 polluted cities in the report, Global Air Pollution 2018.<
